title: Arrays of strings
description:
Write in `solution.c`:

```c
size_t longest(const char *words[], size_t count);       /* index of the longest; the first if tied; count >= 1 */
void sort_words(const char *words[], size_t count);      /* alphabetical (strcmp), moving the pointers */
size_t split(char *line, char *parts[], size_t max);
        /* splits line at spaces IN PLACE: writes '\0' after each word and stores a pointer to each word
           in parts, at most max of them; returns how many. Several spaces in a row count as one. */
void advance(const char **cursor, size_t n);             /* moves *cursor forward n characters,
                                                            stopping at the terminator */
```
